Method of Attack: NTLM relay attack forcing a server or domain controller to authenticate against an NTLM relay server controlled by the attacker
Unauthenticated forced authentication on domain controllers using MS-EFSRPC API functions
Abuse of EFSRPC functions such as EfsRpcEncryptFileSrv, EfsRpcDecryptFileSrv, EfsRpcQueryUsersOnFile, EfsRpcQueryRecoveryAgents, EfsRpcRemoveUsersFromFile, EfsRpcAddUsersToFile
Impacted Systems: Windows Server 2012 R2 (updated with July 2021 Updates)
Windows Server 2008 R2 (updated with January 2020 Updates, no Extended Security Updates)
Attack Vector: MS-EFSRPC API functions via LSARPC and EFSRPC named pipes
NTLM relay forcing domain controller authentication
